Chapter 259 0256 An Unexpected Incident at the Book Signing

The location for this book signing in Jingcheng was once again set at Oriental Plaza.

Unlike last time, when they worried no one would show up, this time there was no need to pay people to stand in line.

Because Chen Guiliang himself already had many fans, not to mention he had just been caught in a storm of public opinion. His fame had reached a new high.

Even the property management company of Oriental Plaza had taken the initiative to make a banner at their own expense: A Warm Welcome to the Esteemed History Author, Teacher Chen Guiliang, for His Book Signing at Oriental Plaza.

"After the book signing is over, how about I arrange a few TV shows for you to coordinate with the publicity for the upcoming book sales?" Li Xunhuan said.

Chen Guiliang said, "This isn't the eve of the Spring Festival. It's not that easy to get on good shows."

Li Xunhuan smiled, "Now, you're the one picking the shows, not the other way around. Especially after the public controversy, a lot of TV shows want to have you on."

Chen Guiliang asked, "What shows are there to choose from?"

Li Xunhuan listed them off: "Dialogue, Face to Face, Yang Lan One on One, Behind the Headlines with Wen Tao, Tiger Talk, A Date with Luyu…"

"Haha, I thought you were going to say Art Life and Happy Camp," Chen Guiliang joked.

Li Xunhuan said, "If you want to go on those two, I can help make the arrangements. You can definitely get on Happy Camp; your status and influence are more than enough. But you'll have to wait in line for Art Life. Their guests for next month have already been decided, and it's very difficult to cut in line."

Chen Guiliang asked, "Last time there was that Oriental Night Talk with Liu Yiwei. Why didn't you mention it this time? I thought my chat with Liu Yiwei was quite pleasant."

Li Xunhuan explained, "Oriental Night Talk was canceled this summer."

"Didn't that show have super high ratings? Why was it canceled?" Chen Guiliang was a little surprised.

Li Xunhuan shook his head, "I don't know why it was canceled. There are all sorts of rumors. The mainstream view is that it was to make way for talent shows, but it might also be related to declining ratings. It was probably a combination of various factors."

Chen Guiliang said, "Help me pick three shows. Too many is pointless. Let's focus on Jingcheng and Shanghai. I can record them when I go to Shanghai for the book signing."

Li Xunhuan said, "Then let's go with Dialogue, Yang Lan One on One, and Behind the Headlines with Wen Tao."

"Behind the Headlines with Wen Tao?" Chen Guiliang hesitated.

He had really liked it when he was younger, but later grew to dislike it. Later still, he neither liked nor disliked it, viewing it with an indifferent heart.

Li Xunhuan thought he had other concerns and explained, "Many of Phoenix TV's shows have moved their recordings to Jingcheng these past two years. Right now, Behind the Headlines with Wen Tao is 70% recorded in Jingcheng and 30% in Hong Kong. They've already shifted their focus to the mainland. I'll just arrange for you to be on an episode recorded in Jingcheng."

Chen Guiliang thought for a moment, "Alright. But you have to get me a beautiful female guest."

Chen Guiliang didn't want to chat nonsense with greasy middle-aged and old men, many of whom were biased.

Li Xunhuan was a loyal viewer of Behind the Headlines with Wen Tao and was quite familiar with the show's guests. He asked with a smile, "You remember Chang'e from Lotus Lantern, right?"

Chen Guiliang nodded, "I remember. Yan Danchen."

Li Xunhuan said, "This year, she's been on Behind the Headlines with Wen Tao every so often. She's practically become a regular female guest. Whenever Dou Wentao is recording in Jingcheng and can't find a female guest, he pulls Yan Danchen in to save the day."

"That works," Chen Guiliang readily agreed. It was always best to have a beauty to feast his eyes on.

Li Xunhuan called Dou Wentao on the spot. They chatted for a while and set the recording for three days later, to be aired the following week.

Chen Guiliang smiled, "CEO Lu, your connections are truly extensive."

Li Xunhuan said, "I met him through a mutual friend. That friend is also a writer, named Feng Tang. And Feng Tang is just like you, writing books while doing business. He's a senior partner at McKinsey & Company."

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: Of course I know Feng Tang. He later became the CEO of China Resources Healthcare Group. In fact, he was the one who founded it. Then, his good friend and benefactor fell from grace, and Feng Tang quietly left China Resources.

Li Xunhuan said, "Feng Tang is a very interesting person. I'll take you to visit his siheyuan in Jingcheng some day."

"Holy crap, he has a siheyuan," Chen Guiliang said with genuine envy.

"He also has a bay-view villa in the United States. He's doing extremely well," Li Xunhuan said. "This guy is incredibly arrogant in his writing. He criticized Shen Congwen for lacking a scientific spirit, said that Cao Yu's later plays were all no good, accused Bing Xin's translation style of being too soft, and even enraged Li Yinhe when he commented on Wang Xiaobo. But in real life, he's actually very humble. When friends visit his home, he always stands at the door waiting to greet them."

Chen Guiliang chuckled, "Don't go on about all that. He's most famous for writing smut in his books. You think I haven't read his works?"

"Hahaha." Li Xunhuan burst out laughing.

It was almost time for the book signing, and the two of them headed to the venue together.

On the way, people were already greeting them.

"Whoa, so many people?" Chen Guiliang's scalp tingled at the sight, and his wrist involuntarily felt like twitching.

His hand was definitely going to cramp up from all the signing today!

Li Xunhuan had also invited some reporters, mainly from the literary supplements of well-known newspapers and the literature channels of major web portals.

When the reporters arrived, they too were stunned by the scene of the queue.

"Did they hire people to line up?"

"Probably not. With so many people, there's no need to hire stand-ins. And if they were all stand-ins, they wouldn't need to hire so many."

"This is insane. Not even Han Han or Guo Xiaosi could draw a crowd like this!"

"Chen Guiliang became especially famous after the public controversy a while back."

"He could become a tycoon just from selling books."

"This year's Hurun Rich List comes out in a little over a month. I wonder where Chen Guiliang will rank."

"He'll probably make the list. As long as the financing information has been publicly disclosed in the official media, Hurun will also estimate the value of unlisted companies."

With Chen Guiliang's current net worth, he could probably rank in the 200s on this year's Hurun Rich List.

The number of tycoons in this bracket was particularly high. A net worth of 1 billion could only get you to 325th place, while 2 billion could get you to 152nd.

Chen Guiliang said to Li Xunhuan, "Let's start early. The sooner we sign, the sooner we can wrap up. There are just too many people."

"Alright."

Among those in line, there were many students and young people who had graduated a few years ago. These were the ones who genuinely bought books to read.

There were also quite a few white-collar and gold-collar workers who were shopping at Oriental Plaza, especially female white-collar workers. They had been shopping at Oriental Plaza today, going in and out of high-end brand stores and cafes, and when they heard CEO Chen was holding a signing, they rushed over to join the queue.

After the report on Xinwen Lianbo, coupled with the buzz in the local media, which white-collar worker in Jingcheng didn't know of Chen Guiliang?

In the eyes of those female white-collar workers, Chen Guiliang's primary identity was that of a company CEO, while his status as an author was a cultural bonus. They liked either identity, and the combination of the two was even more appealing.

Purchasing a signed book from CEO Chen was enough to display their elegant taste!

As for whether they would read it after buying it, that was another matter entirely.

There were actually fewer out-of-town tourists lining up this time than last. Because the line was too long today, the tourists felt it was a waste of time.

"Liang-ge, can you sign this set of Legends of the Three Kingdoms too?" a boy who looked like a student asked. He had come to line up very early today and was also holding a tin box edition of Legends of the Three Kingdoms.

Chen Guiliang really liked this kind of fan. He said while signing, "You should read less for leisure and play fewer games. Focus on your studies."

The boy smiled, "I go to Beijing No. 4 High School, and my grades are pretty good."

"Then pretend I didn't say anything. You can play however you want," Chen Guiliang took back his previous words.

No matter how young a Jingye was, they were still a Jingye, let alone a young Jingye from Beijing No. 4 High School.

The boy, having received his signed new book and cards, said cheerfully, "Liang-ge, when the champion skins come out, I'm definitely buying the whole set."
